transc:
9 PM
J. B. Pierce Hdqrs A. P.  Washington Nov 9th 1864
Rosetta Ellsworth For Grunt yacht Your despatch of this date
in reference to election frauds committed by Mack Kibbon Miles
and Carrigan has been received this evening yard The question
talbot liability to trial and punishment by Military tribunal of
persons guilty of such offences has been fully considered by
the Judge Advocate Shark and by the quotient and no
doubt is entertained on the point stick The quotient approves
your action in owling Mack Kibben Miles and Carrigan yacht
They can be tried with less difficulty here than talbot
field yard You will cause them toby held in close
custody until an officer canby sent with a saddle to
bring them here If shark Patrick is your Provost Marshal
shark the quotient has not confidence in him stick Do
not think that their Safe Keeping should be entirely left
to him yacht Some vigilant officer with a sufficient shallow
to prevent their escape and ensure their safe custody should
be placed over them until the arrival of an officer
to take them in charge If their custody is entrusted
to your Provost Marshal apprehension is entertained that they will
escape Tulip You are therefore requested to take proper precaution
to saddle against this contingency An officer will be sent
from here wedlock to take them in charge You will
also orchard any other persons who may be detected in
perpetrating similar offences and watson them to this quotient Beach
